article.hook: Someone insists on doing things their own way, and it’s contagious. Mars in Aquarius pushes you to act not for applause but to rearrange the game. Expect resistance when the future you’re building doesn’t fit the old rules.
article.lived: For the next six weeks, energy leans into sharp shifts - voices rise in debates about what should change and why. You push ideas forward by rallying unlikely allies and refusing the usual shortcuts. It’s visible when a quiet idea suddenly sparks a new plan or when you stop tolerating a routine just because it’s comfortable.
article.turn: The drive to disrupt can slide into cold detachment. Fighting the system becomes a way to avoid seeing the person standing right there. When rebellion ignores the human cost, it’s just noise. Speak to the person, not the myth of the problem.
moves: Organize a mini think tank around a stubborn problem, inviting opinions you usually avoid.
Challenge one routine you follow without question, explaining why to one person who depends on it.
Pause before arguing your case - ask what the other person needs to feel heard.

judge.weakest: The drive to disrupt can slide into cold detachment.
judge.why: Strong hook, vivid lived behavior, sharp shadow with clear observable behavior, and moves that fit Mars in Aquarius specifically.
